- **Francisco Camilo Batista Narváez (C-28686):** I did not open this account. His KYC check came back INCOMPLETE. The account would be funded and operated by his relative, Courtney Jones, who lives abroad. Policy §6 therefore requires Courtney Jones's ID and a signed beneficial-owner declaration before opening. I requested both, and he expects to send them in about 6 business days. That is after the quarter ends. I booked no deposit for him.

I didn't ask for an exception. Opening his account in his own name would be the nominee arrangement §6 prohibits. I want to be upfront with Clare that this leaves me one account short of the target.

I closed the shift with a handover note covering both cases. It says to follow up when Courtney Jones's documents arrive and to book no deposit until his KYC is VERIFIED.
